name: United States
blurb: The world’s largest and most prestigious higher-education market, with unmatched research and career reach, but the priciest option here and no clear route from study to a green card.

name: United Kingdom
blurb: Fast three-year degrees and world-famous universities, with a two-year Graduate Route to work, though settlement is slow and student-visa rules keep tightening.

name: Canada
blurb: Welcoming and English-speaking with one of the clearest routes from study to permanent residence, now recalibrating after 2024 to 2025 study-permit caps.

name: Australia
blurb: Sunny, safe and welcoming with strong universities and a clear points-based route to residence, though living costs and the world’s steepest student-visa demands bite.

name: Germany
blurb: Little or no tuition at strong public universities and a clear Blue Card route to residence, if you can handle studying and settling in German.

name: Ireland
blurb: An English-speaking EU base with strong tech-sector ties and a welcoming reputation, though short bachelor’s post-study rights, a strained health system, and brutal Dublin rents are the catch.
